newsitem.title: USA: Mattel names Harry Pearce CFO.
newsitem.headline: Mattel names Harry Pearce CFO.

text.p: Mattel Inc said Thursday that Harry Pearce had joined the company as chief financial officer, effective May 1.
Pearce will replace Francesca Luzuriaga, who has accepted the position of executive vice president-worldwide business planning and resources, it said.
Pearce was chief financial officer of Tyco Toys Inc before the company's merger with Mattel last month, it added.

Mattel, which makes children's toys, also reported a net loss of $0.72 for the first quarter against a profit of $0.07 for the same period a year ago. The figure includes a $0.73-a-share charge incurred for its merger with Tyco.
